name: Produce Violations Report
description: Transforms analysis:violations into spec_validation_result for dashboard display.

prompt.template:
Transform analysis:violations into spec_validation_result shape.

Read the analysis:violations from outputs/analysis-violations.json

Produce results/specification-violations.json:
{
  "shape": "spec_validation_result",
  "totalViolations": <count from input>,
  "timestamp": "<current ISO date>",
  "specId": "error-handling",
  "compliance": <1 - (violations/total_checks)>,
  "violations": <copy from input>
}

The compliance score is the ratio of passing checks to total checks.
